headline: Standard Engineering Technology submits SEBI Regulation 74(5) certificate
summary: Standard Engineering Technology has filed its compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) with the market regulator. This procedural filing confirms the dematerialisation of shares and verifies that securities received for dematerialisation have been duly processed. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for listed entities. Indian retail investors generally see no direct financial impact from this procedural compliance.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your portfolio.
